channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Lee | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Lee from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on David Lee
item.description:
It was a full circle moment for Green, who'd started all but two of the 597 games he's played for the Warriors since Kerr chose him to replace two-time All-Star David Lee in his first season as coach back in 2014.

“The biggest thing for me is that I can walk in the room and say, 'Coach, I need to come off the bench.' Because I watched David Lee hug me, put his arms around me no matter what the situation was and say, 'This is what you need to do,'”

Draymond Green on David Lee, Apr 24, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on David Lee
item.description:
“David Lee was in front of me -- David Lee was a great vet to me by the way, I love D-Lee to this day. But when we're in practice, I'm trying to take David Lee's head off,”

Draymond Green on David Lee, Oct 16, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on David Lee
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on not playing Lee:

“If we needed him, he'd play. I decided I'd rather have him healthy for the playoffs.”

Gregg Popovich on David Lee, Apr 2, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on David Lee
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on David Lee:

“He’s a smart and experienced player, and he’s got talent. He figured out pretty quickly how he fits into this equation.”

Rick Carlisle on David Lee, Feb 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on David Lee
item.description:
#Mavs FChandler Parsons on David Lee:

“He’s slowed down a little bit the last two years. But I think for our system he’ll be good.”

Chandler Parsons on David Lee, Feb 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on David Lee
item.description:
Dwain Price:Dirk Nowitzki on David Lee:

“He drives, he rebounds, which sometimes we have issues with our rebounding. So he should help us there.”

Dirk Nowitzki on David Lee, Feb 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Brad Stevens on David Lee
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Brad Stevens on David Lee sitting in blowouts:

“He’s been in the league a long time... I’m not gonna put him in there for 5 mins or 4 mins at the end.”

Brad Stevens on David Lee, Jan 31, 2016. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on David Lee, Amir Johnson
item.description:
“I think [Celtics president of basketball operations] Danny [Ainge] picked some of these guys [based on their desire to help Boston build]. I think we’ve brought in guys, just as an example, David Lee and Amir Johnson, we’re not bringing in divas,”

Wyc Grousbeck on David Lee, Amir Johnson, Oct 17, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Joe Lacob on David Lee
item.description:
“I can tell you that at the trade deadline, there was discussion from others that we should move David Lee, and some people (thought) we were going to move David Lee, and I can tell you that we all sat there and said, 'No, we're not going to do that, no matter what the cost might be next year,'”

Joe Lacob on David Lee, Jun 14, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on David Lee
item.description:
“I don’t know if that trade would have gotten us to this point. I didn’t think it would be a huge upgrade. David Lee provides the same output, besides the 3-point shooting. I thought we could have just found a stretch 4 at the veteran’s minimum — someone like James Jones.”

Andrew Bogut on David Lee, Jun 10, 2015. Source: Grantland.

item.title: Mark Jackson on David Lee
item.description:
GSW coachMark Jackson on David Lee:

“I don't know what his role will be going forward. ... He put himself in position to inspire his team.”

Mark Jackson on David Lee, May 3, 2013. Source: Twitter @Rusty_SFChron.

item.title: Mark Jackson on David Lee
item.description:
Rusty Simmons:Mark Jackson on David Lee:

“We can’t replace him. We know that. That’s the thing we have to know right away.”

Mark Jackson on David Lee, Apr 21, 2013. Source: Twitter @Rusty_SFChron.

item.title: Keith Smart on David Lee
item.description:
“I've been around our team for a long time and the NBA. The guy was not going on a road trip, but he brought two cakes for the team to take on the road. ... That's a true teammate that our guys have in David Lee.”

Keith Smart on David Lee, Nov 26, 2010. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.
